independent_sampling_execution_contract.material_discrepancy_definition: Any difference that changes the core ruling, prototype identity, operating-state effect, number/unit/denominator, evidence authority, G0/approval boundary, public right, professional veto, figure meaning or implementation gate.
independent_sampling_execution_contract.fail_closed_rule: A missing sample result, cannot-determine result or unresolved material discrepancy prevents independent-human equivalence signoff; deterministic bilingual PASS remains only a packaging result.

contributor_precheck_results.evidence: BME-01 through BME-11 and EQ-01 through EQ-09 record contributor-side structural, claim, number, status, position and media-accessibility comparisons.
contributor_precheck_results.limit: This precheck helps a human reviewer sample efficiently but cannot populate human_result, reviewer identity, independence or signoff fields.

formal_human_review_packet.signoff_rule: Do not change the independent-human status until a real reviewer completes every sample, records discrepancies and signs the result.

open_boundary.effect: This record supports contributor-side editorial QA only. It must not be presented as independent human confirmation or certified translation.

non_certification: This is a contributor-side editorial equivalence record produced by the submission agent.
